summary: Android local preview capture no longer waits forever for the first native video frame: a five-second timeout removes the frame sink and returns an error, while an atomic completion gate protects against duplicate timeout/late-frame replies. The local thumbnail queue can retry after a failed capture. This addresses a failure path found during source audit; the user's app-only preview symptom is not confirmed fixed until device acceptance.
